<issue>
CSE incorrectly deduplicates duplicate calls to volatile functions (uuid(), random()) inside aggregate/window expressions
### What happens?

When the same volatile-function expression (`uuid()`, `random()`, `gen_random_uuid()`) is used as input to two textually identical aggregate/window calls in the same SELECT list, the planner deduplicates them via common subexpression elimination (CSE) and evaluates the volatile function only once, reusing that single value for both output columns instead of evaluating each occurrence independently.


### To Reproduce

```sql
select g,
    any_value(uuid()::varchar) over (partition by g) as id_a,
    any_value(uuid()::varchar) over (partition by g) as id_b
from (values (1),(1),(2),(2)) t(g);
-- id_a = id_b
```

Actual result — id_a equals id_b on every row:

Expected: id_a and id_b independently generated, no relation between the two columns.

Making the two expressions textually different (but semantically equivalent) removes the collision : 
```sql
select g,
    any_value(uuid()::varchar) over (partition by g) as id_a,
    any_value((uuid()||'')::varchar) over (partition by g) as id_b
from (values (1),(1),(2),(2)) t(g);
-- id_a != id_b
```

The same query pattern on PostgreSQL (gen_random_uuid()) returns two independent, distinct values per row, confirming this is a DuckDB-specific defect rather than a standard SQL ambiguity.


### OS:

Linux (WSL2)

### DuckDB Version:

1.5.2 and 1.5.4

### DuckDB Client:

Python, jdbc

### Hardware:

_No response_

### Full Name:

input.instruction: In /testbed (DuckDB), find the window-expression common subexpression handling: where window expressions with identical expressions are deduplicated in the planner/binder (e.g. src/planner/binder/query_node/plan_select_node.cpp, bind_select_node.cpp, or src/execution/window_executor / physical_window; also CommonSubExpressionOptimizer). Specifically find code that dedups BoundWindowExpression (probably via Equals / ExpressionMap or 'window_expressions' with Equals comparisons). Report file, line numbers, and code snippets. Also check how BoundAggregateExpression/BoundWindowExpression::Equals handle IsVolatile / how Expression::IsVolatile works.

content.content: {"summary":"No binder-time deduplication of identical window expressions exists. Window expressions are appended unconditionally, and BoundWindowExpression::Equals is only used by the generic CSE pass on LOGICAL_PROJECTION/AGGREGATE nodes, not on LogicalWindow. Expression::IsVolatile is a recursive child check, and BoundWindowExpression/BoundAggregateExpression don't override it.","findings":["src/planner/expression/bound_window_expression.cpp:27-67: BoundWindowExpression::Equals compares base Expression::Equals, ignore_nulls, distinct, start/end, exclude_clause, aggregate, window, bind_info, children, partitions, filter_expr. It is not called from any window-dedup path.","src/planner/binder/expression/bind_window_expression.cpp:384-388: each bound window is stored with ColumnBinding::PushExpression(node.windows, ...) and returns a new colref at (window_index, window_idx). No Equals check, so duplicate windows get separate slots.","src/planner/column_binding.cpp:22-30: PushExpression always does expressions.push_back(new_expr) and returns the new index. No dedup.","src/planner/binder/query_node/plan_select_node.cpp:170-173: statement.windows is moved into LogicalWindow->expressions with no dedup.","src/planner/binder/query_node/bind_select_node.cpp:148-158: the only Equals-based dedup in the select binder is for DISTINCT ON targets (bound_distinct->target_distincts), not windows.","src/optimizer/cse_optimizer.cpp:37-46: CommonSubExpressionOptimizer::VisitOperator only runs ExtractCommonSubExpressions for LOGICAL_PROJECTION and LOGICAL_AGGREGATE_AND_GROUP_BY, not LOGICAL_WINDOW.","src/optimizer/cse_optimizer.cpp:59: CountExpressions skips expressions that are BOUND_AGGREGATE or IsVolatile(). Case at line 78 handles BOUND_WINDOW by falling into the default branch, which recurses into children.","src/planner/expression.cpp:41-50: Expression::IsVolatile() is virtual and returns true if any child (via ExpressionIterator::EnumerateChildren) is volatile. Overrides exist for BoundFunctionExpression (src/planner/expression/bound_function_expression.cpp:29-30, true if function stability is VOLATILE).","BoundWindowExpression and BoundAggregateExpression do not override IsVolatile (grep found no override in their .cpp/.hpp files), so a window's volatility is determined only by its child expressions. Not verified whether EnumerateChildren covers partitions/orders/filter for windows.","The window executor/physical window code (src/execution/window_executor, physical_window) was not searched in depth; no dedup logic was seen there in the grep results."],"confidence":0.7}

input.instruction: In /testbed grep src/ for places where BoundWindowExpression / window expressions are compared with Equals or deduplicated/shared (e.g. in src/execution/operator/aggregate/physical_window.cpp, src/function/window/*, src/optimizer/*, window_executor, 'shared' 'same' 'matching' 'Equals' near 'wexpr'/'window'). Report file:line and snippet of each such place.

content.content: {"summary":"Window-expression equality and sharing happens in four main places: full structural Equals in the bound-window class, CSE dedup in physical planning, a same-ordering check in the top-N window optimizer, and expression-level column sharing in WindowSharedExpressions. Ordering-prefix sharing (GetSharedOrders) is used by the window function executors. physical_window.cpp itself has no Equals-based dedup; its 'shared' references are to the sink state and the shared-expression layout. Nothing was modified.","findings":["src/planner/expression/bound_window_expression.cpp:27-90 — BoundWindowExpression::Equals: compares Expression base, ignore_nulls, bind_info, children (ListEquals), partitions (ListEquals), filter_expr, arg_orders (line 81), start_expr/end_expr (line 87). Full structural equality used for dedup.","src/planner/expression/bound_window_expression.cpp:112-122 — static GetSharedOrders(lhs, rhs): returns length of the common prefix of two BoundOrderByNode vectors, 0 on first mismatch (uses orders[i].Equals at line 117).","src/planner/expression/bound_window_expression.cpp:125-127 — GetSharedOrders(other) delegates to the static version over this->orders vs other.orders.","src/planner/expression/bound_window_expression.cpp:130-145 — KeysAreCompatible: requires PartitionsAreEquivalent, then equal order size and element-wise orders[i].Equals (line 138).","src/execution/physical_plan/plan_window.cpp:98-122 — CSE elimination: window exprs in the same partition group are collected in `matching`; each new wexpr is checked with `wexpr.Equals(match_expr)` at line 120, and if it matches, projection_map reuses the earlier output column (line 121). Partition check is over_expr.PartitionsAreEquivalent(wexpr) at line 95.","src/optimizer/topn_window_elimination.cpp:618-622 — requires every window.expressions[i] (i>=1) to be Equals() to first_window_expr, else the optimization is rejected.","src/function/window/window_shared_expressions.cpp:6-24 — RegisterExpr dedups expressions via shared.columns.find(*pexpr) (hash/equality map keyed by Expression); non-volatile matches return the existing column index, volatile expressions get a new column.","src/function/window/window_executor.cpp:12-26 — WindowExecutor registers range/boundary expressions via shared.RegisterCollection/RegisterEvaluate, so sharing relies on RegisterExpr dedup; wexpr.WindowFunction()->GetSharing(...) at line 26.","src/function/window/window_rank_function.cpp:28, window_rownumber_function.cpp:28, window_value_function.cpp:267 and 1499/1555, window_aggregate_function.cpp:45 — use GetSharedOrders(...) == arg_orders.size() to decide whether an arg-ordered aggregate can reuse the main ordering.","src/function/window/window_naive_aggregator.cpp:185-190 — KeyEqual compares index keys for the naive aggregator; this is a row comparison, not expression dedup.","src/execution/operator/aggregate/physical_window.cpp:630-632 — reads GetSortedExpressions(gsink.shared.coll_shared) to build the per-column expression list; no Equals or dedup logic in this file."],"confidence":0.8}
